subcategory_gloss: earth and atmospheric science: surface climate observation and climatological summaries
domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by climatological observing practice as a cooperative observer network's handbook fixes it: which calendar day a once-daily maximum and gauge reading belong to for morning and afternoon observers, accumulated gauge amounts after unread days, traces, degree days on the 65 F base with each day's mean rounded, the mean temperature of a complete month, inclusive threshold days and dated extremes. The deliverable is a station's monthly climatological summary, an earth-science data product; code is the medium, not the subject.
evidence: instruction.md: symptoms are observers' and data users' complaints about crediting, degree days, mean temperatures, threshold counts, extremes and traces
environment/app/docs/observer-handbook.md: numbered network handbook CN-7 part 3 (units and rounding, observation day, crediting, temperature, degree days, precipitation, layout)
planned verifier: whole-summary comparison of every station's figures against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, derived from the handbook
